title: 10800007: verified literal no-open-root-cover theorem and published note
body:
This PR gives the complete negative answer to the literal formulation of Vassiliev’s 2015 Problem 2A: no ordinary-open cover of the full six-dimensional coefficient space can support continuous point-valued exact real-root selections, at any cardinality. Every neighborhood of zero contains the complex square-root obstruction; a translated family shows that deleting only zero does not repair the question.

The classical obstruction and the source’s own slice are credited. A bounded primary-body priority audit did not authenticate an earlier explicit diagnosis of this exact family, but historical firstness and guaranteed novelty are not established. The paper discloses unread sources and version limits. No result is claimed for an unspecified repaired finite-genus problem or approximate Problem 2B.

The three-page preprint, standalone source and verification package are published at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23355942. The tracker entry is 'Math Puzzles'!A82:D82.

Validation: independent source, mathematical and computational adversaries; three independent priority approaches; two successive NEW whole-package adversarial reviews. The first package review found an incorrect Python minimum, corrected globally to Python 3.11+ in v2; the second found no actionable issue. The 30 exact-control runs reproduce four valid PASS results and 26 expected invalid-or-unsupported rejections in ordinary/optimized modes. Universal polynomial bounds supplement the written topological proof; finite sampling is not the proof. Current sampled diagnostic guards were repaired to remain active with optimization, with originals preserved as dated history.

AI tools were used extensively in solving, drafting, sourcing, reproducing and auditing this work. The preprint is unrefereed and has not undergone conventional human peer review. Original substantive proof-search effort remains 1/5.
